description:
- **Claim:** composition.B1
- **Owner:** `jido.agent`
- **Observed:** a module listing itself, or two modules listing each other, never finishes `Kernel.ParallelCompiler.compile/2`. The hot stack is `Jido.Agent.Validation.define/2` → `DSL.definition!/1` → `Topology.related/3:221` → `Topology.nested/3` → `Topology.member/4`, below `@after_verify {Jido.Agent.DSL, :verify!}` (`lib/jido/agent/dsl.ex:109`). The elixir checker is stuck, so there is no error at all.
- **Cause:** `lib/jido/agent/topology.ex:216-221` keeps a `seen` list and has a `:recursive_membership` error, but it calls `module.definition()`, which re-enters `Validation.define` with a fresh `seen`. The guard can never fire.
- **Repro** (10 s per case, then prints the stack):

```bash
mix run --no-compile tmp/guide-reports/probes/01c_self_member.exs 2>&1 | grep -a -A9 '^N4'
```

- **Guide:** the cycle warning in the composition tutorial can stay, reworded to name the compile error.
- **Proposed task (P1):** "Report cyclic topology membership at compile time". Done when self and mutual cycles give a `:recursive_membership` error with a file and line.

Source: guide-report triage, finding B07. Reproduction probes are gitignored and exist only in the main checkout under tmp/guide-reports/probes/. Full evidence: tmp/guide-reports/triage-findings.md and probes/results-*.md. Add a test and any contract change in this change, and remove or correct the listed guide text. The guides must be committed before a fix edits them.
title: Report cyclic topology membership at compile time
